description.value:
Tier Undying

Activate 1 action to invoke

Frequency once per day

Duration rest of the encounter

Effect The Answer stops being limited to a single trigger — any opening an opponent within your reach gives you gets punished as a reaction, up to once per enemy turn

The Answer stops rationing itself.

cinderfall.incomplete: Removes The Answer's once-per-round trigger limit, up to once per enemy turn. Granting an additional/extra use of an existing named reaction is a fixed bucket-3 case in this pass: always INCOMPLETE regardless of actionType or any real analog's own unencoded shape.
